class="wixui-rich-text__text">Welcome to Icarai Kite Village &ndash; Your hotel near the beach in Icaraizinho, Brazil</span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Ideally located just 250 meters from the fine sandy beaches of Icaraizinho, our Icarai Kite Village pousada is the perfect choice for your family vacation, weekend break, or extended stay. Nestled in lush greenery, our holiday homes and chalets offer you a haven of peace and serenity surrounded by nature.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Warm and equipped accommodation:</span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our accommodation, including air-conditioned rooms, spacious suites and cozy bungalows, is carefully decorated to guarantee great comfort. We have accommodation equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi access, some with flat screen TV and refined bedding. You can enjoy our covered terraces with garden furniture for unforgettable moments of relaxation.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Quality services and facilities:</span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our charming hotel offers generous and delicious breakfasts as an option. Our rooms and suites, equipped with a private bathroom, are perfect for nights of great comfort. Our cottages and bungalows can accommodate families and groups, with seasonal rental options and special offers for last minute bookings. We also organize Transfers from the airport, on-site excursions and Kitesurfing and Wingfoil stays.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">An unforgettable experience :</span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Staying at Icarai Kite Village means choosing a dream destination to recharge your batteries and relax. Whether you come for a relaxing weekend or an extended vacation, our vacation village promises you memorable moments. Our warm and welcoming hotel team is on hand to make your stay as pleasant as possible.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></section><section
